release_notes:
ENHANCED STABILITY UPDATE v1.1.1

BUILDS ON v1.1.0 WITH ADDITIONAL FIXES:

CRITICAL ENHANCEMENTS:
1. Browser Count Decrement Fix - Fixed auto-close disabled causing resource timeouts
2. User Config Respect - Max concurrent now respects user settings (was overridden)
3. Enhanced Resource Management - Multiple safety improvements

ALL v1.1.0 FIXES INCLUDED:
1. 200+ Accounts Crash Fix - Tool stable with unlimited accounts
2. Batch Cleanup Fix - No false 'Failed' status
3. Auto-Start Fix - Works with 50+ accounts
4. Resource Timeout Fixes - Complete solution (3-part fix)

KEY IMPROVEMENTS:
- Browser count decrements on worker finish (not browser close)
- Prevents resource timeouts when auto-close disabled
- User config respected (max concurrent)
- Max concurrent increased to 50 (was 20)
- Dynamic batch size adjustment
- Protected PIDs system for slow workers
- Worker self-managed browser counting

STABILITY:
- Memory controlled at 8GB max per batch
- Process count limited to 120 max
- All seeding settings fully respected
- Memory leak prevention (5x faster GC)
- Smart worker protection
- Accurate status reporting
- Zero false failures
- Zero resource timeouts

SAFETY:
- Multiple protection layers
- Memory threshold (85%)
- CPU threshold (90%)
- Dynamic resource limits
- Graceful degradation
- Industry-standard safety

TIME ESTIMATES:
- 200 accounts: ~7-8 hours
- 400 accounts: ~15 hours
(Conservative timing for stability)

This is a CRITICAL stability update - All users should upgrade!
